summary: ATI Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of $450M aggregate principal amount of 5.875% Senior Notes due 2033. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, mature June 15, 2033, and pay interest semi-annually from June 8, 2026. Proceeds to ATI (before expenses) are $444.9375M. The notes are not listed on any exchange. Joint book-running managers include Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
